newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market not well tested- USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market not well tested- USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet, with not enough slaughter steers or heifers sold for a market test, USDA said. Inquiry moderate, demand light.
Sales confirmed on 100 slaughter steers and 100 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 13,900 head, including 11,400 head previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - pen mostly Select, few Choice 2-3 1350 lbs 64.00. Slaughter heifers - pen Select and Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 64.00.
Confirmed - 200 last week - none last year - none
